newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP steel output falls in August.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP steel output falls in August.

text.p: The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd, Australia's only primary steel producer, said on Tuesday its steel output in August slipped four percent but total despatches within and from Australia and New Zealand rose five percent.
BHP produced 730,000 tonnes of steel in August, compared with 764,000 tonnes in August 1995, but total despatches rose to 724,000 tonnes from 691,000.
Domestic despatches in Australia fell and despatches within New Zealand were flat compared with August 1995, but this was more than offset by a rise in export despatches, BHP said.

"Australian domestic despatches for the quarter were three percent below the same period last year, reflecting a flat domestic market and increased import activity due to the strength of the Australian dollar," BHP said.
"Export despatches from Australia were significantly higher, however the increase was mainly semi-finished product," it said.
"Higher despatches from New Zealand reflect the timing of shipments," the company said.
"Competition in international steel markets remains intense," it said.
NOTE: August is the third month of BHP's June/May year.
